players.name: Aaron Wiggins
players.comment: Wiggins won't return to Monday's preseason game against the Grizzlies due to a cut to his inner lip. He'll end with seven points (2-4 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT) in 11 minutes.

players.name: Luguentz Dort
players.comment: Dort won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Grizzlies due to a right knee contusion, Kevin Chouinard of the Hawks' official site reports.

players.name: CJ McCollum
players.comment: McCollum is out for Monday's preseason opener against the Grizzlies due to a nose contusion, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Henri Veesaar
players.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

players.name: Mouhamed Gueye
players.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Joshua Jefferson
players.comment: Jefferson (lower back) is out for Tuesday's preseason game against Charlotte, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

players.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
players.comment: Brown (ankle) will miss Tuesday's preseason game against the Hornets, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

players.name: Brandon Miller
players.comment: Miller (leg) is listed as out for Tuesday's preseason game versus the Nets.

players.name: Christian Anderson
players.comment: Anderson (ankle) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nets.

players.name: Kylan Boswell
players.comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.

players.name: Coby White
players.comment: The Hornets announced Monday that White suffered a left calf strain during training camp and will not play during the preseason.

players.name: Kon Knueppel
players.comment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

players.name: Grant Williams
players.comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

players.name: Zach Collins
players.comment: Collins (toe) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

players.name: Jaylin Sellers
players.comment: Sellers (back) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

players.name: Tre Jones
players.comment: Jones won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

players.name: Nic Claxton
players.comment: Claxton tweaked his hamstring and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network of the Bulls Radio Network reports.

players.name: Peyton Watson
players.comment: Although head coach Kenny Atkinson said the starting lineup for the beginning of the 2026-27 season is not yet set, he praised Watson's (hamstring) fit in Cleveland and added that "there's a lot of room for growth in his offensive game," Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.

players.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
players.comment: Johnson (lower leg) is expected to play in Friday's preseason opener against Houston, per Brad Townsend of The Dallas Morning News.

players.name: Santi Aldama
players.comment: Aldama (undisclosed) was limited during Saturday's practice, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reported.

players.name: Dereck Lively II
players.comment: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri said Friday that Lively (foot) is "making good progress" in his recovery, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

players.name: Spencer Jones
players.comment: Jones (hamstring) did not play during Tuesday's 93-79 preseason win over the Jazz.

players.name: Jalen Duren
players.comment: Duren (rest) is expected to play at some point this preseason, per Hunter Patterson of The Athletic.

players.name: Al Horford
players.comment: Horford (rest) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against Portland, per Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com.

players.name: Gui Santos
players.comment: Santos (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

players.name: Brandin Podziemski

players.name: Gary Payton II

players.name: Georges Niang
players.comment: Niang (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against Portland, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

players.name: De'Anthony Melton
players.comment: Melton (rest) won't travel with the Warriors for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

players.name: Yaxel Lendeborg
players.comment: Lendeborg (rest) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Stephen Curry
players.comment: Curry generated 16 points, 4-7 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 5-6 FT), five assists and two rebounds across 14 minutes in Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers.

players.name: Draymond Green
players.comment: Green will be limited to around 20 minutes in Tuesday's preseason contest against the Lakers and won't travel to Portland for Wednesday's back-to-back against the Trail Blazers, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Kristaps Porzingis
players.comment: Porzingis (undisclosed) remains out indefinitely, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

players.name: Jimmy Butler III
players.comment: The Warriors hope to have Butler (knee) back early in 2027, per Keith Watkins of Yahoo Sports.

players.name: Moses Moody
players.comment: Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.

players.name: Larry Nance Jr.
players.comment: Nance (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against Minnesota, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

players.name: T.J. McConnell
players.comment: McConnell (undisclosed) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Minnesota, per Tony East of Forbes.com.

players.name: Johnny Furphy
players.comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

players.name: Kobe Sanders
players.comment: Sanders (hip) was limited to individual player development work and did not take part in five-on-five activity Wednesday, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Sanders is day-to-day.

players.name: Bradley Beal
players.comment: Beal (knee) isn't participating in five-on-five work and is doing individual player development work, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Wednesday that Beal is continuing to have inflammation managed.

players.name: Max Strus
players.comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
players.comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Brandon Ingram
players.comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

players.name: Jordan Miller
players.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

players.name: Arthur Kaluma
players.comment: Kaluma (lower body) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game Golden State, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

players.name: Collin Sexton

players.name: Walker Kessler

players.name: Luka Doncic

players.name: Matisse Thybulle

players.name: Austin Reaves

players.name: Isaiah Stewart

players.name: Keshad Johnson

players.name: Pelle Larsson

players.name: Andrew Wiggins

players.name: Dru Smith
players.comment: Smith will miss a couple weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Nate Ament
players.comment: Ament won't return to Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder due to a left ankle sprain. He'll finish with three points (1-7 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-4 FT), four rebounds, one assist and one steal in 10 minutes.

players.name: Donte DiVincenzo
players.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jose Alvarado
players.comment: Alvarado (knee) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the 76ers, Steve Popper of Newsday reports.

players.name: Thomas Sorber
players.comment: Sorber (knee) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

players.name: Chet Holmgren

players.name: Nikola Topic

players.name: Isaiah Hartenstein

players.name: Jaylin Williams

players.name: Noah Penda

players.name: Anthony Black

players.name: Jalen Suggs

players.name: Jonathan Isaac

players.name: Izaiyah Nelson
players.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

players.name: Dominick Barlow

players.name: Anfernee Simons

players.name: Adem Bona

players.name: Tyrese Maxey

players.name: LeBron James

players.name: Joel Embiid

players.name: Miles Bridges

players.name: Mark Williams

players.name: Shaedon Sharpe

players.name: Keegan Murray
players.comment: Murray (undisclosed) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Lakers, Sean Cunningham of Fox 40 Sacramento reports.

players.name: Malik Monk

players.name: Ben Simmons

players.name: Jayden Quaintance

players.name: Tobias Harris

players.name: David Jones Garcia

players.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis

players.name: Nate Bittle

players.name: Lauri Markkanen

players.name: Tristan Vukcevic

players.name: Jamir Watkins
